channel.title: Purnendu Dash: Writing
channel.description: Founder and product architect behind MultiVendorX, DualCube and VuloLabs, building eCommerce and eLearning software on WordPress and WooCommerce.

item.title: Why most WooCommerce marketplaces get vendor payouts wrong
item.description: Commission handling is the first thing that breaks when a WooCommerce store grows into a real marketplace. Here is what usually goes wrong, and how to design around it.

item.title: LMS and ecommerce do not have to be separate systems
item.description: Most course platforms and most online stores are built by different teams solving different problems. When a business needs both, that split shows up as broken workflows.

item.title: Fifteen years of building an open source WordPress plugin
item.description: Lessons from maintaining MultiVendorX since 2015, from community support to keeping a plugin compatible with a decade of WordPress and WooCommerce releases.

item.title: A founder's guide to multi-vendor commission models
item.description: Choosing a commission structure is a business decision as much as a technical one. A short breakdown of the models that actually work for marketplaces.

item.title: Speaking at WordCamp: lessons from organizing and presenting
item.description: Notes from being both a WordCamp speaker and organizer, and what that experience taught me about explaining technical products to a non-technical room.
